en-US.longDescription: aidbg is a single-file C++17 Windows native debugger based on TitanEngine. It exposes a GDB-aligned command set (run / start / continue / stepi / nexti / finish / bt / break / hbreak / mbreak / watch / condition / ignore / registers / set / x / dump / disas / search / strings / info / attach / detach / thread) plus a JSON Lines machine interface (--json) for AI coding assistants, CI automation and scripted debugging. It supports software, hardware and memory breakpoints, dll!api breakpoints, deep PDB symbol support with source/PDB checksum validation, exception interception and multi-thread debugging.
en-US.name: aidbg
